verdict.rationale: cubic's AI wiki automatically indexes the whole codebase and produces searchable wikis with source links and architecture diagrams, kept current in the repo. Its MCP server and chat also expose codebase context to agents without manual file selection. missing for 10: interactive agent-driven exploration of an unfamiliar repo beyond PR-scoped chat, depth documentation on how the wiki explains architecture, independent or hands-on corroboration of wiki quality
